title: Run Fable 5 And GPT 5.6 In One Setup
description:
You can have Claude Fable 5 driving and GPT 5.6 answering inside the same terminal, and it takes one command from OpenAI's own docs. The catch is that you end up paying two meters at once.

#shorts #claudecode #gpt5
